info.title: Lupira Career API
info.description: Career and professional-history backend for Lupira. Authenticate with a Bearer token issued by the OIDC provider (Authentik).

get.summary: The caller's resolved local identity (JIT-provisioned on first login).
The caller's full composed résumé (profile + engagements + projects + skills).
The caller's unified experience timeline (engagements + projects).
The caller's profile (an empty shell if none exists yet).

put.summary: Create or replace the caller's profile.

get.summary: A published portfolio (profile + engagements + projects + skills + experience + media + artifacts), filtered to public items.

ArtifactSkillRoleRequest.description: Body for linking an artifact to a skill (the skill id is in the route).

ExperienceItemDto.description: One row of the unified experience timeline (engagements + projects).

Location.description:
A lightweight, denormalized location value (city/country) attached to engagements and skill edges.
            Distinct from the calendar API's hierarchical Place catalog — the career API only records where work happened,
            not logistics.

MediaProjectRoleRequest.description: Body for linking a media asset to a project (the project id is in the route).

PublicPortfolioDto.description:
The composed public portfolio for one published handle: the profile header plus the published subset of
            each collection (archived projects/media/artifacts and retired skills filtered out; goals never included). Built
            from the same per-resource DTOs the owner surface returns, so the wire shapes stay identical.

RescopeGoalRequest.description: Partial update (PATCH): only non-null fields are applied, each emitting its own domain event.

ResumeDto.description: A composed résumé: the public profile header plus the published engagements, projects, and skills.

SkillEdgeContext.description:
Where a skill edge happened. SkillEdgeContext SkillEdgeContext.External(string label, string? url = null) with string? SkillEdgeContext.ExternalUrl is also the soft,
            one-way link to a calendar API entity (e.g. a cal item that evidences applying the skill).

SkillMaturityDto.description: A skill's current maturity plus the trajectory that produced it.

SkillTimelineDto.description: The chronological edge history of one skill.

UpdateEngagementRequest.description:
Partial update (PATCH): only non-null fields are applied, each emitting its own domain event.
            Supplying DateOnly? UpdateEngagementRequest.End ends the engagement.

UpdateSkillRequest.description: Partial update (PATCH): only non-null fields are applied, each emitting its own domain event.

Bearer.description: OIDC bearer token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
